question.text: Let $P$ be the point $(2,0)$ and $Q$ be a variable point on $(y-6)^2=2(x-4)$. Then the locus of mid-point of $P Q$ is

solution.text:
$$
\begin{gathered}
\mathrm{P}(2,0) \\
\mathrm{Q}\left(4+\frac{1}{2} \mathrm{t}^2, 6+\mathrm{t}\right)
\end{gathered}
$$
Let midpoint of $\mathrm{PQ}$ be R(h, k)
$$
\begin{aligned}
&\mathrm{h}=3+\frac{1}{4} \mathrm{t}^2, \mathrm{k}=3+\frac{\mathrm{t}}{2} \\
&\Rightarrow(\mathrm{k}-3)^2=(\mathrm{h}-3) \\
&\Rightarrow \mathrm{y}^2-6 \mathrm{y}-\mathrm{x}+12=0
\end{aligned}
$$
